pre_condition: self is an ElpClient instance with an active connection to an ELP server. self._messages is a thread-safe blocking queue containing items representing server messages. deadline is an absolute monotonic time value (as returned by time.monotonic()) representing the latest acceptable arrival time for the next message.
post_condition: When the current monotonic time is at or past deadline upon entry, raises TimeoutError with message 'timed out waiting for ELP'. Otherwise, blocks the caller until an item is available in self._messages, bounded by the time remaining until deadline. When the time remaining elapses before an item becomes available, raises TimeoutError with message 'timed out waiting for ELP', chaining the queue-empty exception as the cause. When the retrieved item is an instance of BaseException, raises RuntimeError with the exception's string representation as the message, chaining the original exception as the cause. Otherwise, returns the retrieved item without transformation.
